answer: One enforceable rule: threshold the attestation graph's conductance to flag dense mutual-voting cliques. Link analysis on reused seeds marks the whole set. Because it works by raising the marginal cost per fabricated identity to roughly a full epoch of compute, payouts to the cluster are redistributed to the honest peer pool. The network ties the falcon to sunk effort, uses the pearl as an corroborating signal, then requires a ledge before any payout.
